title: Understanding Systematic Investment Plans (SIP)
content: A Systematic Investment Plan (SIP) is an investment method offered by mutual funds allowing investors to invest a fixed sum of money at regular intervals (daily, weekly, or monthly) into a chosen mutual fund scheme. SIP promotes financial discipline and leverages rupee cost averaging—buying more units when prices are low and fewer units when prices are high. This mitigates market timing risk and harnesses long-term compounding growth.
